title: securityheaders api is dead. this is the curl i use now
description: The securityheaders.com API is no longer accepting new API keys and is effectively deprecated. Users are advised to switch to an alternative API provided by https://httpsornot.com, which offers similar functionality for checking HTTP security headers with a rate limit of 120 requests per hour per IP without requiring an API key. The new API uses a different JSON response format and grading system. This change does not represent a security vulnerability but rather a service discontinuation and migration notice.

aiSummary: The original securityheaders.com API has ceased issuing new API keys, limiting its usability for automated security header checks. An alternative API at https://httpsornot.com provides similar functionality without requiring an API key for up to 120 requests per hour per IP address. The new API returns JSON data with a different structure and grading scheme. Rate limiting and response codes differ from the original API, with 422 indicating a header grade below B and 429 indicating rate limiting. This is a service change announcement rather than a software vulnerability or exploit.
aiImpact: There is no direct security impact or vulnerability disclosed. The main effect is that users relying on the securityheaders.com API for automated security header assessments must migrate to the new httpsornot.com API or find alternative solutions. Failure to do so may disrupt automated security header scanning workflows.
